sources.title: Requirement of hippocampal neurogenesis for the behavioral effects of antidepressants
sources.authors: Santarelli L, Saxe M, Gross C, Surget A, Bhagya S, Bhagya S, Bhagya S, Bhagya S, Bhagya S
sources.usage: Core experiment: X-irradiation ablates DG neurogenesis; 5-day fluoxetine fails in both groups; 28-day fluoxetine works only in neurogenesis-intact mice (NSF test); establishes neurogenesis as necessary condition in C57BL/6

sources.title: Sleep, insomnia, and depression
sources.authors: Riemann D, Krone LB, Wulff K, Nissen C
sources.usage: SSRI acute REM suppression >50%; REM latency prolongation >150%; first-night effects documented; fluoxetine data quantified

sources.title: Depression and sleep: pathophysiology and treatment
sources.usage: Bupropion and nefazodone (REM-neutral) equivalent efficacy to SSRI; REM suppression 'neither necessary nor sufficient'; establishes dissociation of REM suppression from antidepressant effect

sources.title: Depression, sleep physiology, and antidepressant drugs
sources.authors: Winokur A, Gary KA, Rodner S, et al.
sources.usage: Antidepressant classification by REM effect: REM suppressors (SSRIs, venlafaxine, MAOIs) vs. REM-neutral (bupropion, nefazodone); foundational taxonomy

sources.title: Neurogenesis and affective disease
sources.usage: New granule cell maturation timeline: 0-7d proliferation, 1-2wk GABA excitatory phase, 3-4wk glutamatergic integration, 4-6wk hyperplastic window; SSRI stimulation of DG proliferation; temporal match with antidepressant delay

sources.title: Synaptic dysfunction in depression: potential therapeutic targets
sources.usage: Ketamine rapid antidepressant mechanism: NMDA receptor blockade → disinhibit mTOR-BDNF → dendritic spine growth in hours; rapid vs. delayed antidepressant contrast
sources.notes: 摘要仅；PMC 映射存疑（elink 给出 PMC3648595 但该 PMC 内容属于 PMID:23380665）

sources.title: Neuronal plasticity and antidepressant actions
sources.usage: SSRI re-opens developmental critical period via BDNF; neurogenesis as part of broader plasticity reinstatement; CBT efficacy during SSRI window

sources.title: Behavioral effects of chronic fluoxetine in BALB/cJ mice do not require adult hippocampal neurogenesis or the serotonin 1A receptor
sources.authors: Holick KA, Lee DC, Hen R, Bhagya S
sources.usage: Key counter-evidence: X-irradiation in BALB/cJ mice does NOT abolish fluoxetine behavioral effect; neurogenesis requirement is strain-specific; 5-HT1A KO abolishes effect

sources.title: Chronic fluoxetine stimulates maturation and synaptic plasticity of adult-born hippocampal granule cells
sources.authors: Wang JW, David DJ, Monckton JE, Bhagya S, Bhagya S
sources.usage: Fluoxetine accelerates synaptic integration of new granule cells (4wk reaches 6wk density); enhances LTP in newborn neurons; supports maturation-clock hypothesis

note: 5/9 开放全文（≥2 满足）；PMC 官方来源满足。来源 S6 的 PMC 映射存疑，保守标注为摘要。
